originalAssessment.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations/friction; 10 exceptional in assessed use. Scores judge observed mobile interaction and presentation, not win/loss or displayed accuracy. No desired score applied.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, atmospheric short mission with accessible assist paths and informative feedback; dense landscape HUD and limited continuous manual-control evidence keep this below excellent.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE+FIRE drag worked in visible patrol combat; tap aim, scene swipe, zoomed FIRE and DASH produced observable results. Cover strike and aiming correction occurred. Physical thumb comfort and continuous held rearming remain unknown.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil armor/open feedback, patrol charges and deck defense provided understandable changes in task. Route assistance carried much traversal; this cannot grade unassisted navigation depth or sustained enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rain, wet lighting, industrial silhouettes, teal objectives and restrained terminal panel form a consistent atmosphere. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Large context-sensitive hold control, map route, explicit objective transitions, auto reload and terminal assist accounting are helpful. Need to distinguish onscreen target from offscreen direction cue added inspection effort.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and objective labels were strong. Small world signage, dark geometry, a concealing pillar, and simultaneous threat/interaction/status overlays made 844x390 visually busy.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Entry guard and visible perimeter sentinel; TARGET DOWN / SENTINEL DOWN feedback. Second patrol shot with tap aim and anchored FIRE.
coverage.turn: Scene swipes changed heading 334→353 and 278→238; corrected to visible patrol.
coverage.dash: Tapped visible DASH; cyan displacement and 4.3 cooldown; no phase evade established.
coverage.aim: Zoomed FIRE capture; ammo 21→20, COVER AIM CLEAR. Miss/cover strike, no aimed combat success established.
coverage.failures: AIM shot hit cover; rear hit reduced shield 60→41; coil armor shots and empty magazine/reload. Continuous held rearming unassessed.
coverage.manual_assistance_note: Target tap assistance used before manual MOVE+FIRE drag; down feedback does not prove unassisted precision or per-shot accuracy.

attempts.route: Recovered Mara, Sera, Elian using route/approach holds; three coils disabled, planning map inspected and visibly closed, deck upload completed.

coverage.turn: Tap aiming visibly changed heading 000→304 for patrol, later 326→020. Dedicated scene swipe sampled in attempt 1 only.
coverage.aim: Tap guard, tap AIM, FIRE hold; captureHeld screenshot visibly zoomed, TARGET DOWN, ammo 30→21. Next resumed unzoomed capture inspected before further coordinates.

Coil armor/open windows varied; no per-shot hit/miss count inferred from terminal 100%. Early DASH not established as evade. Held contact captures interrupt continuous bursts.

helpful: Zoomed guard burst visibly connected after the earlier cover miss
PHASE EVADE +75 and cooldown gave clear DASH confirmation
Coil percentages, auto reload, extraction percent and terminal assist counts explained progress

attempts.route: Recovered Mara, Sera, Elian using route/approach holds; disabled coils; returned to deck and remained through upload. Assisted completion is not full manual traversal coverage.

originalAssessment.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limitations, 10 exceptionally clear and comfortable across assessed use. Scores are holistic judgments of observed emulated interaction, not win grades or physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, accessible short mission with effective feedback and assistance. Dark scenes, small labels and view changes demand inspection; sustained touch comfort remains unknown.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag, swipe turn, AIM and DASH all responded visibly. Tap aim helps acquisition. Zoom cover failure and armor-only burst preserved; no proven evade or uninterrupted rearming comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, coil status phases and defended upload provide clear progression. Manual patrol engagement worked. Strong route assistance and paused observations limit judgment of pacing, tension and continuous enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/orange palette, rain, wet ground, large title and restrained end screen support atmosphere. Blocky scene and heavy overhead geometry sometimes dominate view. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach labels, threat directions, memory checkmarks, map legend, automatic reload and upload percentages explain next actions. Fresh reset and terminal summaries are clear.
reasons.readability: Primary HUD health/ammo and objective labels are strong. Distant guards, small world signs and dark cover are harder to distinguish; stacked objective/threat overlays consume portrait space.

coverage.manualMoveFireDrag: Opening guard: ammo 30 to 21, TARGET DOWN. Visible perimeter patrol after turn: simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag, ammo 20 to 18, LAST SENTINEL DOWN. Tap aim assisted both engagements; not pure manual aiming.
coverage.turn: Scene swipe 010 to 333; later 315 to 278 to expose patrol.
coverage.dash: Visible DASH tapped after opening guard; cyan edge and cooldown 4.3 observed. No evade established; terminal phase evades 0.
coverage.aimZoomFire: AIM visibly zoomed. Re-enabled after pause for 500ms FIRE: ammo 21 to 20, COVER AIM CLEAR, no enemy hit demonstrated.
coverage.objectives: Assisted route/approach recovered three memories; tapped visible coils and fired, including partial damage and auto reload; returned and held deck; shot two visible deck threats.

failuresUncertainties: Zoomed shot hit cover; no successful zoomed enemy engagement established.
Not all rounds individually attributable to hits; terminal accuracy 92%.
Automatic releases prevent assessing continuous held-burst rearming comfort.
helpful: Memory checkmarks and coil OFF indicators
Auto reload and explicit upload progress
frustrating: Small world labels and dark cover silhouettes
Tap aiming rotates view, requiring reacquisition

coverage.turn: One scene swipe to expose patrol; tap aim also rotated heading to 240.
coverage.map: Opened planning map, viewed overview route, legend and receiver names; visibly closed with #close-map. No mission advancement presumed while planning.
coverage.objectives: Assisted route/approach for all three memories; four coil bursts (coil I left at 5%, reload, corrected finish; coil III off); returned to deck, shot two interceptors, waited for terminal upload.

failuresUncertainties: Initial zoom burst only armor hit, not a kill.
Coil I required follow-up after 5% remainder and reload.
100% terminal accuracy is reported UI data, not independent per-projectile verification or proof all gestures optimal.
No continuous held-burst rearming assessment; each capture released contacts.
DASH sampled but successful evasion unproven.
helpful: Map route and explicit wall/low-cover legend readable in portrait
Armor-hit feedback made incomplete guard engagement apparent
Fresh-start reset objective, health, shield and ammo visibly
Coil percentage and reload feedback explained need for another burst
frustrating: Guard armor consumed zoom burst without kill
Large close guard and sight obscure some scene
World signage small and partly occluded; overhead dark structure can fill much of scene

remaining: Dark cover, muted patrols and small signage
Limited mission breadth and unassessed natural pacing
limits: Paused synthetic Chromium/software WebGL. One landscape terminal records a phase evade; no human timing or causal compass-benefit conclusion. Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance, continuous controls and enjoyment remain unassessed.
